newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT says domestic call earnings growing.
newsitem.headline: PLDT says domestic call earnings growing.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT), the country's dominant telecommunications firm, said revenue from domestic calls was growing at a rate of 26 percent per annum.

"Domestic toll is now increasing at a very fast rate, something like 26 percent (annually)" PLDT senior vice president, corporate services group, Antonio Samson, told Reuters in an interview on Monday.
"That's changing," Samson said when asked about the company's traditional dependence on revenues from international calls.
This dependence has in the past made the company vulnerable to exchange rate fluctuations and falling rates for international calls.
Samson said PLDT's income from international calls had gone down to 58 percent of total revenue from about 65 percent three years ago.
"The rise in domestic call growth has been for two years already so it is not a fluke," he said.
Samson attributed the growth in domestic calls to higher economic activity in the country as well as the firm's three-year old expansion programme.
